reason: The studio's category union and write-allowlist had no way to express or display a `friction` artifact, so a valid write was rejected as an invalid category.
An existing coverage tool parses .tsx sources under ScriptKind.TS, so its AST silently misses assertions and understates coverage.
The ADR-NNNN placeholder convention cannot distinguish a session's own unallocated reference from the corpus's generic any-ADR pattern token, so a substitution could not tell them apart.
The `--real` build verb adopts and then terminates the launching session's presence declaration, an incorrect write by an existing command.
Spawned builders ended their turn awaiting a notification that never comes, stopping before the lane's objective was achieved and requiring an orchestrator nudge.
The bare-vite launch path boots successfully and then 500s every API route with an error naming a workspace package rather than the missing loader — a misleading failure from an existing invocation.
The declared proof command exits 0 on `No projects matched the filters`, so the CONFIRM_RED phase halts with a message pointing at the leaf instead of the missing scaffold.
A `.strict()` wire shape behind a deliberately fail-silent writer drops every usage event without any red, so the existing capture mechanism silently discards data on an additive producer field.
No mechanism exists to invalidate or re-check a brief's negative-existence premise against concurrent sibling landings, so the mandate had been discharged with nothing able to say so.
check:coverage ran and passed 7/7 while validating against a test title rather than the contract's clauses, so unasserted clauses read as proven in a signed verdict.
The gate orders its ten-second claim check after typecheck and the full test suite, so a cheap-to-fix failure costs an entire gate re-run.
The mirror-conformance fence checks only one of the re-composed routes, so the /api/activity mirror drifted with only part of the outcome ever verified.
No claim or mutex exists for the friction queue at all, so two adjudicator seats drained it concurrently with nothing able to refuse or warn.
check:corpus-content's V=0 ceiling is scoped per-repo rather than per-author, so an existing rung scores a sibling's live edits against the session running the gate.
An existing command fails to resolve the house `@path` convention and performs a wholesale record replacement, destroying the prior verdict while reporting success.
The machine offers no durable checkout to host the hook, so a machine-scoped registration binds enforcement to whatever branch an unrelated checkout is sitting on.
Node/tsx resolve module format and `@storytree/*` specifiers from the script's own directory, so a scratchpad-resident script cannot reach workspace packages regardless of the repo's code.
The delivered sheet and PNG dir carry no per-cell record of the code state that produced them, so a two-variable comparison is indistinguishable from a one-variable one.
renderArcRollup fixes an ordering that buries the arc's only actionable section behind its entire history, so truncation silently removes it while the render looks complete.
The AUTHOR_TEST phase's 16-turn budget exhausted twice on a two-file unit that a scoped worker proved immediately — a bad budget in an existing verb.
The probe ran but its stable-picture predicate validated against a partial activity counter, admitting frames whose other visual inputs had changed.
The authoring session shipped a comparative that steers target choice without checking it against two artifacts already in the store, and both halves were false on the day it was written.
The lifecycle rule is computed from the increment log alone and cannot see chip-carried work, so an arc auto-closed with its own end state unmet.
The check holds both facts at report time but prints only the routine staleness signature, so its documented remedy is actively wrong for this case.
No edge, tag, gate rung or curator mechanism exists to detect a semantic cross-ADR falsification of a prescribed build address, so the cost lands on whoever builds it.
`gate:bg`'s detach only holds when nothing keeps stdout open, so the natural act of piping its banner silently SIGTERMs the whole gate run.
The fence ran but asked about the branch's diff rather than the promise it encoded, reporting a broken promise where there was none and staying green where there was.
No kind-agnostic or field-agnostic text search over the corpus exists, so the absence the pass needed to prove is unfalsifiable at reasonable cost.
The non-vacuity guard ran and passed while counting opaque pixels over already-opaque ground, a measurement that cannot move for the defect it is read as covering.
A Linux-CI rmdir race in temp-fixture teardown reds the job on branches touching nothing near it, and a bare re-run passes with no code change.
capture.mjs hardcodes a steady-state 30s goto budget with no override, so the first cold-vite capture in any worktree refuses with a message naming the page instead of the transform.
Bun is installed on the dev box but absent from the shell PATH, so a green package reads RED for a machine reason nothing in the message names.
The `uat run` path passes its observe runner raw where `adopt` memoizes it, so an existing verb re-runs one deterministic suite once per criterion.
An existing probe observes only a browser-logged-in CLI and prints a fix hint prescribing an invariant a later ADR retired, producing a false FAIL with a dangerous remedy.
The `--rerun-failed` comparison asserts 'nothing was fixed in between' in a provable register while being structurally unable to see the store write that fixed it.
The session published figures from a measurement file it never typechecked, so a mis-parameterised call ran to completion and its plausible output went uncorroborated.
The rung's closing message names only two remedies and omits the correct third, steering the reader toward tests that cannot pass or an EQUIVALENT marker that freezes dead code.
The driver's COMMITTED_RUNG default builds a URL for an asset that is not in the repo, so the published reproduce command 404s on a fresh checkout.
A skip-capable rung fails to take its skip branch on a fresh worktree, so it reds at origin/main for every branch regardless of content while CI never runs it.
Passing `--arc` alongside `--discharged-by` re-arms a fence the exemption documents away, and the refusal prescribes minting a second increment for work that already landed.
